entry.title: Durable and HA task queues and DAG workflows in Go
entry.summary: ebind is an MIT-licensed Go library that gives you a persistent task queue and a durable workflow engine on a single dependency - NATS JetStream - which it can embed right inside your process. Every background-job story in Go seems to start the same way: pick a queue library, then stand up the infrastructure it drags along. Redis for Asynq or Machinery. Postgres for River. A whole cluster if you want Temporal-style workflows. The job code is ten lines; the deployment diagram is not. ebind is my attempt at a different trade: one dependency - NATS JetStream - carries the queue, the workflow state, and the event bus.
